Question: Can I do all work on mobile like desktop?
Answer: BUSY Mobile App helps you bill on the go, share invoices instantly, check live stock & receivables, and receive faster payments. It reduces dependency on desktop, improves coordination between office & field staff, and gives you real‑time business control from mobile.

Question: Will invoice format be same as desktop?
Answer: Yes, BUSY lets you use the same invoice format in mobile as configured in desktop; layout, logo, font, and fields are the same.

Question: Will invoice numbering remain same?
Answer: Yes, BUSY supports same voucher/number series between desktop and mobile; numbers stay consistent and no duplicates are created.

Question: Can I use multiple companies in mobile app?
Answer: Yes, BUSY Mobile App allows multiple companies, each with its own financial years. To add one: tap the Company Name at the top > Add Company > fill in the details > Proceed. You can switch between companies from the dropdown at the top.

Question: Can I use app if system is off?
Answer: Yes, you can use the mobile app even when your desktop system is off. You can view synced data and do basic work on mobile. Once your desktop system is turned on and connected, all data will automatically sync between desktop and mobile.

Question: If system is off full day, can I still do billing from mobile?
Answer: Yes, you can do billing in the mobile app. The app will generate temporary numbers while the desktop is off, and once your system is turned on, all data will sync automatically with correct voucher series.

Question: Can I create GST bills / E-way bills from mobile?
Answer: Yes, BUSY Mobile App lets you create GST invoices and E‑Way Bill directly from mobile.

Question: Can I enter purchase, payment, and receipt entries?
Answer: Yes, you can create Sales/Purchase invoices, Payments, and Receipts in mobile; they sync with BUSY Desktop.

Question: Can I modify bills from mobile app?
Answer: Yes, you can modify bills in the mobile app until they are synced with desktop. Once the bill is synced, you must edit it from the desktop, not from the mobile app.

Question: Can I delete bills from mobile app?
Answer: In BUSY, you cannot delete an invoice; you can only cancel it. You can cancel the invoice from the mobile app until it  not  synced with desktop. Once it is synced, you must cancel it from the desktop, not from mobile.

Question: Can I share invoices on WhatsApp/email?
Answer: Yes, you can share invoices as PDF or URL via WhatsApp, email, directly from the invoice screen.

Question: Is barcode scanning available?
Answer: Yes, BUSY Mobile App supports barcode/QR code scanning items.

Question: Can I track stock and inventory?
Answer: Yes, mobile shows stock status,; batch/godown‑wise tracking is usually configured in desktop and viewed via reports.

Question: Can I view reports like ledger/outstanding?
Answer: Yes, mobile app lets you view account ledger, party‑wise, item‑wise, and outstanding reports, including ageing receivables/payables.

Question: Is data automatically synced?
Answer: Yes, data can be automatically synced if auto‑sync is enabled in BUSY. You can enable auto‑sync through BUSYagent and set the interval. Once configured, mobile and desktop will sync data automatically in real‑time or at that interval, without manual upload.

Question: How much time does sync take?
Answer: Sync usually happens in a few seconds to a few minutes, depending on your internet speed and how the dealer has set the autosync interval in BUSYagent (for example every 2–5 minutes). If autosync is ON, data automatically uploads within that interval without manual upload.

Question: Do I need to manually sync data?
Answer: If auto‑sync is enabled in BUSYagent, then no, data syncs automatically at the set interval. If auto‑sync is not ON, or if there’s any delay, you may need to manually sync from the app or BUSYagent once.

Question: Is internet required to use the app?
Answer: Yes, working on BUSY Mobile App requires internet for sync, creation, and real‑time data; some offline viewing is possible if data is already synced.

Question: Is data सुरक्षित and where is it stored?
Answer: Yes, data is सुरक्षित (secured) in BUSY. Your main data stays in the BUSY desktop data folder on your own computer. For mobile app access, the data is synced to a secure cloud over the internet (via BUSY Agent), so the app can show it anywhere. The desktop data can also be backed up to a local drive, external drive or Google Drive.

Question: Do I need separate backup for mobile?
Answer: No, you do not need a separate backup for mobile. Your main data stays and is backed up in BUSY Desktop (BUSY Data folder and BUSY Agent); for the mobile app it is synced to a secure cloud, and the app shows that same data. As long as you keep your desktop backup (local or Google Drive), your data is safe and recoverable.

Question: Will desktop data reflect in mobile automatically?
Answer: Yes, desktop data will reflect in mobile automatically once cloud sync is enabled and configured in BUSYagent. As long as auto‑sync is ON and both desktop and mobile have internet, any new voucher, ledger, or master created in desktop will appear in the mobile app within the set sync interval (usually every few minutes).

Question: Do I need desktop approval for sync?
Answer: No, sync is automatic if BUSYagent is configured; approvals apply to vouchers or user rights, not data sync itself.
